tools.name: trengo_list_tickets
tools.description: List tickets (conversations) visible to the token's user, newest activity first, with channel and latest message. Filter by status, contact, assignee, channel, label, last message direction or update time. Trengo: GET /tickets.

tools.name: trengo_list_ticket_messages
tools.description: List the messages of one ticket — inbound, outbound and internal notes — with the contact or agent behind each. Trengo: GET /tickets/{ticket_id}/messages.

tools.name: trengo_get_email_message
tools.description: Fetch the full email behind one message of a ticket: original HTML body, from, to, subject and Message-ID. The message must be an email message. Trengo: GET /tickets/{ticket_id}/full_email_messages/{message_id}.

tools.name: trengo_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts, or search them by name, email or phone number. Trengo: GET /contacts.

tools.name: trengo_get_contact
tools.description: Fetch one contact with name, email, phone and custom field data, optionally with notes. Trengo: GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: trengo_list_contact_groups
tools.description: List the contact groups in the account — use their ids with trengo_update_contact. Trengo: GET /contact_groups.

tools.name: trengo_list_users
tools.description: List the agents (users) in the Trengo account — use their ids to assign tickets or filter. Trengo: GET /users.

tools.name: trengo_list_teams
tools.description: List the teams in the account — use their ids to assign tickets to a team. Trengo: GET /teams.

tools.name: trengo_list_labels
tools.description: List the ticket labels (tags) in the account, for filtering tickets and reports. Trengo: GET /labels.

tools.name: trengo_list_ticket_results
tools.description: List the ticket results (closing outcomes, e.g. 'Resolved', 'Sale') that can be applied when closing a ticket. Trengo: GET /ticket_results.

tools.name: trengo_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the custom fields defined for tickets, contacts and profiles. Trengo: GET /custom_fields.

tools.name: trengo_list_quick_replies
tools.description: List the saved quick replies (canned responses), optionally only the messaging or email ones — useful for drafting consistent answers. Trengo: GET /quick_replies.

tools.name: trengo_get_reporting_metrics
tools.description: Aggregate support metrics over a period: new, created, assigned, closed and reopened tickets, average first response time and average total resolution time (seconds). Filter by team, channel, label or direction. Trengo: GET /reporting/metrics.

tools.name: trengo_get_agent_performance
tools.description: Per-agent performance over a period: messages sent, notes, tickets assigned and closed, average first response and resolution times (with and without business hours). Trengo: GET /reporting/agent_performance.

tools.name: trengo_get_ticket_details_report
tools.description: Per-ticket reporting rows: status, assignee, labels, first reply, first resolution and total resolution times (with and without business hours). Filter by team, channel, label, direction, status and created/closed/assigned date ranges; sort by a timing metric. For large accounts page with start_afte

tools.name: trengo_create_ticket
tools.description: Open a new ticket for an existing contact on a channel. Nothing is sent to the customer until you post a message with trengo_send_ticket_message. Trengo: POST /tickets.

tools.name: trengo_assign_ticket
tools.description: Assign a ticket to a user or a team, with an optional assignment note. Reversible by reassigning. Trengo: POST /tickets/{ticket_id}/assign.

tools.name: trengo_close_ticket
tools.description: Close a ticket, optionally applying a ticket result (see trengo_list_ticket_results). Reversible with trengo_reopen_ticket. Trengo: POST /tickets/{ticket_id}/close.

tools.name: trengo_reopen_ticket
tools.description: Reopen a closed ticket. Trengo: POST /tickets/{ticket_id}/reopen.

tools.name: trengo_send_ticket_message
tools.description: Post a message on a ticket. With internal_note=true it is an internal note visible only to agents. OTHERWISE IT IS DELIVERED TO THE CUSTOMER on the ticket's channel (email, WhatsApp, chat...) and cannot be recalled — confirm the text first. Trengo: POST /tickets/{ticket_id}/messages.

tools.name: trengo_create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact on a channel. The identifier is the contact's address on that channel: an email address for email channels, a phone number for WhatsApp/SMS/voice. Trengo: POST /channels/{channel_id}/contacts.

tools.name: trengo_update_contact
tools.description: Rename a contact and/or set the contact groups it belongs to. contact_group_ids REPLACES the contact's groups. Trengo: PUT /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: trengo_create_board_card
tools.description: Create a card (e.g. a deal or task) in a stage of a Trengo board. The board id is in the board's URL in Trengo. Trengo: POST /boards/{boardId}/cards.

tools.name: trengo_update_board_card
tools.description: Partially update a board card: rename it, move it to another stage, or set its users (owners) and contacts (leads). user_ids / contact_ids replace the current sets. Trengo: PUT /boards/{boardId}/cards/{cardId}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: trengo_list_tickets, trengo_list_ticket_messages, trengo_get_email_message, trengo_list_contacts, trengo_get_contact, trengo_list_users, trengo_list_teams, trengo_list_labels, trengo_list_ticket_results, trengo_list_custom_fields, trengo_list_quick_replies, trengo_get_reporting_metrics, trengo_get_agent_performance, trengo_get_ticket_details_report, trengo_create_ticket · Private data: trengo_list_tickets, trengo_list_ticket_messages, trengo_list_contacts, trengo_get_contact, trengo_list_contact_groups, trengo_list_custom_fields, trengo_create_ticket, trengo_create_contact, trengo_update_contact, trengo_update_board_card · Public sink: trengo_get_email_message, trengo_list_contacts, trengo_get_contact, trengo_list_quick_replies, trengo_create_ticket, trengo_assign_ticket, trengo_close_ticket, trengo_reopen_ticket, trengo_send_ticket_message, trengo_create_contact, trengo_create_board_card.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
